_comment: Reference config for the Free Business Registration inbound agent on Retell AI. Retell's dashboard/API field names shift between versions, so treat this as a checklist of settings rather than a literal import file. The content - prompt, functions, voice, greeting - is what matters and is accurate.
_voice_note: Willa is middle-aged British — carries the authority a founder needs when handing over their company details. Amy(UK) reads young and sales-y on this call type.
_voice_model_note: eleven_flash_v2 is ElevenLabs' ENGLISH-ONLY model and must stay that way. The multilingual models (eleven_flash_v2_5, eleven_multilingual_v2) drift a British voice towards American mid-call, which is what made the first demo sound wrong. English-only also has the lowest latency of the three.

response_engine.begin_message: Free Business Registration, Ellie speaking — are you looking to register a company, or is it about one you've already got with us?

_normalisation_note: normalize_for_speech must be on. Prices and phone numbers are read aloud: £399 must land as 'three hundred and ninety-nine pounds', and 0203 432 8551 as digits, not a number.

availability._note: The site advertises 24/7 support, so the agent answers 24/7. Callbacks booked outside 09:00-17:30 Europe/London should be offered for the next working morning.
